LESSON: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CHRISTIAN
Topic 3.2: Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why do we go to church?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate some Christian rituals performed in his/her church for spiritual nourishment
2. Roles play Christian rituals practiced according to different churches to nurture peaceful coexistence among learners.
3. Appreciate taking part in Christian rituals in his/her church to promote the values of love, responsibility and integrity

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Demonstrate some Christian rituals performed in his/her church for spiritual nourishment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate some Christian rituals performed in his/her church for spiritual nourishment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Roles play Christian rituals practiced according to different churches to nurture peaceful coexistence among learners.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to roles play Christian rituals practiced according to different churches to nurture peaceful coexistence among learners. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate taking part in Christian rituals in his/her church to promote the values of love, responsibility and integrity
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate taking part in Christian rituals in his/her church to promote the values of love, responsibility and integrity. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
2. Explain Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why do we go to church?
